title: Backup
intro: A site backup is one zip with the site database, every user's library database and all original photos. It contains password hashes, so keep it as private as the data folder.
withThumbs: Include thumbnails (bigger archive; they can be regenerated)

split.label: Zip size
split.help: A backup bigger than this is written as several zips that belong together. No zip is bigger than this size: a file bigger than it (a long video, a very large database) is not zipped but saved beside the zips as a …-NNN.big file. Keep every zip and .big file in one place: restoring needs every part.

incomplete: Incomplete: part {{missing}} of {{count}} is missing. Upload it to finish this backup.

restore.title: Restore
restore.confirm: Unpack this backup next to the live data? Nothing is replaced until you apply it.
restore.needsMaintenance: Restoring needs maintenance mode, so nobody changes the data meanwhile.
restore.idle: Restore a backup listed above (Restore…), or choose one on the server or on this device. It is unpacked and checked first; nothing is replaced until you apply it.

pending.title: Ready to apply
pending.warn: Applying restarts the server and replaces all data on it with this backup. Anything changed since the backup is gone from the server. Your current data is deleted once the restore succeeds, so make a backup first if you want to keep it.
pending.upgrade: This backup is from an older mosaicWave; its databases are upgraded when the server starts.

restarting.text: Restarting the server and applying the restore… This page reloads when the server is back.
restarting.slow: The server has not come back. If mosaicWave does not restart by itself, start it on the host; the restore is applied when it starts.
restarting.manual: The server does not restart by itself here. Restart it on the host; the restore is applied when it starts.

result.failed: The restore of {{archive}} failed and nothing was replaced: {{message}}
result.kept: Your previous data is kept at:
result.upgrade: The backup was from an older mosaicWave; its databases were upgraded.
result.thumbs: The backup has no thumbnails; they are rebuilt when photos are first viewed.
result.users: User accounts now come from the backup. If you cannot sign in, use the administrator account the backup was made with.
result.maintenance: Maintenance mode is still on. Turn it off when you have checked the result.

offline.title: From the command line
offline.help: A restore can also run offline with the API stopped. Stop mosaicWave, then run this on the host:
offline.check: Add --check to only validate the archive; nothing is changed.
offline.keep: Your current data is kept beside it as *.before-restore-<time> until you delete it.

source.pathPlaceholder: Path to a mosaicwave-site-….zip on the server
source.pickerIntro: Open folders on the server, then choose a zip file. It is restored from where it is; nothing is copied.
source.deviceHint: Choose a mosaicwave-site-….zip. A split backup has several files (…-001.zip, …-002.zip, and perhaps …-003.big): choose all of them together. They are uploaded to the server first (they stay in the list above), so large backups take a while and need free space for the upload and for unpacking.
source.uploadedKept: The backup was uploaded and is in the list above, but the restore did not start: {{message}}

library.title: My library backup
library.intro: Back up only your own library (your photos, albums and their details) as one zip you can download. Restoring replaces your library with a backup; other people are not affected. Thumbnails are not included; they are rebuilt when photos are first viewed.

restore.confirm: Replace your library with this backup? Your current library is deleted once the restore succeeds, so back it up first if you want to keep it.

library.keepNote: Restoring replaces your current library and deletes it when the restore succeeds. Back up your library first if you may want to go back.

source.title: Restore from a file
source.pathPlaceholder: Path to a mosaicwave-library-….zip on the server
source.deviceHint: Choose a mosaicwave-library-….zip made by this or another mosaicWave. A split backup has several files (…-001.zip, …-002.zip, and perhaps …-003.big): choose all of them together. They are uploaded first (they stay in the list above), so large backups take a while.

export.title: Export my photos
export.intro: Copy your photos and videos out as ordinary files, to keep somewhere else or open in other apps. An export is not a backup: it cannot be restored. Use My library backup for that.

layout.label: Folders
layout.plain: Plain folders (one folder per album, the rest in Photos)
layout.takeout: Google Takeout style (with .json files for dates and places)

split.label: Zip size
split.help: A file bigger than the zip size is not put in a zip; it is saved next to the zips.

export.started: Export started. Follow it in the status bar. When it is done it is listed under Settings, Export my photos.
